questions.stem_latex: The depth ($d$) in metres of the water in a wave pool varies as waves are sent out. The depth is measured from the floor and can be modelled by the equation $d=\dfrac{4}{5}\sin at+\dfrac{3}{2}$, where $t$ is the time in seconds and $a$ is a constant. Each wave has a period of 2.5 seconds measured from the peak of the wave to the peak of the next wave.

parts.label: a
parts.latex: Find the exact value of $a$.

parts.label: b
parts.latex: Find the maximum height of the wave.

parts.label: c
parts.latex: Sketch a graph showing the depth of the water over the first 5 seconds.

parts.label: d
parts.latex: Sandy can only touch the bottom of the pool when the height of the wave is less than 1.7m. For what percentage of the first 5 seconds can she touch the bottom of the pool? Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.

The lengths of fish in metres in the harbour are distributed according to the equation,

$$f(x)=\begin{cases}-2x(x^2-1)^3+0.5 & \text{for } 0<x\le 1\\[4pt] -\dfrac{x-2}{2} & \text{for } 1<x<2\\[4pt] 0 & \text{for } x>2\end{cases}$$

People are only permitted to catch a fish whose length is between 0.45 m and $L$ m long. If 60\% of fish in the harbour are within this legal limit, find the value of $L$ correct to 2 decimal places.

solutions.latex:
$u=x-1$, $v=\sin x$

$u'=1$, $v'=\cos x$

$$\begin{aligned}\dfrac{d}{dx}&=\sin x+(x-1)\cos x\\&=\sin x+x\cos x-\cos x\end{aligned}$$

(not required expanded but they need to for part b)

$$\begin{aligned}\int\sin x\,dx+\int x\cos x\,dx-\int\cos x\,dx&=(x-1)(\sin x)+C\\-\cos x+\int x\cos x\,dx-\sin x+C_2&=(x-1)(\sin x)+C\\\int x\cos x&=(x-1)(\sin x)+\cos x+\sin x+C_3\\&=x\sin x-\sin x+\cos x+\sin x+C_3\\&=x\sin x+\cos x+C_3\end{aligned}$$

No penalty for forgetting $+C$, has been penalised earlier

notes: Digital PDF, 62 pages, a trial exam with the whole paper printed TWICE: idx0-31 clean question paper (idx0 cover, idx1 blank, idx2-5 Section I Q1-10, idx6 Section II booklet cover, idx7 blank, idx8-25 Section II Q11-32, idx26-31 writing space); idx32-61 the same paper again carrying the teacher's handwritten (red ink) worked solutions on the answer lines, MCQ answers circled, with tick marks and some mark annotations (idx33-36 Section I, idx38-55 Section II). Questions transcribed from the clean copy, solutions transcribed from the handwriting (no typed solutions exist). No multiple-choice answer sheet or reference sheet in the file. Cover: 'Mathematics Advanced Trial Examination 2023', Ascham School, no AT number printed (Trial = AT4). Section I 10, Section II 90 by margin marks. Q11: heading says (2 marks) but margin mark is 1 and the section total only reaches 90 with 1; kept marks_total 2 and part mark 1, marks_mismatch true. Paper typos kept as printed: Q26(a) 'area of the of the cross section'; Q28(c) 'Eugene saves $500 000 dollars'; Q6 'saving account'; Q23 'modeled'. Q10: the keyed answer (A) uses g(x)=0 although f is undefined at 0 (as printed). Answer boxes for sketches (Q23c, Q24c, Q31c) are empty response boxes with no axes, so no question figure was cropped for them. Q17 and Q2 and Q30 tables are stored as tables; Q17's table is an image on the page (header cell 'n/r' stored as $n/r$). Q30 sample-space working and tiles photo are cropped (q30_1 question, q30_s1 solution). Handwriting points to check: Q6 school wrote 12000(1.0415)^4 = 14119.47 (calculator gives about 14119.6); Q7 school wrote 1=a(4-5)-1 with no cube; Q26(a) school's middle line reads 125x then (-4x^2-2pi x^2+pi x^2)/8 (a slip, final line correct); Q26(b) y'' line written with (pi+pi)/8 rather than (pi+4)/8; Q27 final line 16/3 hard to read but consistent with the working; Q31(d) school's percentage working 1.0485/2.5 shown as 42.0%, then 58.0%. Marks annotations in solutions are recorded only where the teacher wrote them (Q13, Q14a, Q23c, Q24c, Q26b, Q27, Q31d); otherwise marks_breakdown just counts ticks.
